notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
